name: Human breast cancer (Visium CytAssist, SpatialData)
description: Visium CytAssist section of FFPE human breast cancer over its H&E, read from a SpatialData Zarr store: 4,992 spots with whole-transcriptome expression (18,085 genes), from the study that pairs Visium with Xenium and single-cell data on serial sections.

source.citation: Janesick A et al. (2023) High resolution mapping of the tumor microenvironment using integrated single-cell, spatial and in situ analysis. Nature Communications. doi:10.1038/s41467-023-43458-x
